description: This class 'PlacementDirectorResolver' resolves and provides instances of IPlacementDirector based on the provided PlacementStrategy type within the Orleans runtime codebase.

classes.name: PlacementDirectorResolver
classes.description: Resolves an IPlacementDirector for a given PlacementStrategy using dependency injection.

methods.name: PlacementDirectorResolver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resolver with an IServiceProvider instance.

methods.name: GetPlacementDirector
methods.description: Retrieves an IPlacementDirector instance corresponding to the provided PlacementStrategy type.
